title: Age Gate
summary: Prove that a private birth year or birth timestamp satisfies a minimum age threshold.
statement: I know a birth date committed by an issuer, and it proves I am at least the required age at the reference time.

publicInputs.name: current_year
publicInputs.description: Reference year used by the verifier.

publicInputs.name: minimum_age
publicInputs.description: Age threshold the user must satisfy.

publicInputs.name: identity_commitment
publicInputs.description: Public commitment binding this claim to a credential or account.

privateInputs.name: birth_year
privateInputs.description: User birth year from the private credential.

privateInputs.name: credential_secret
privateInputs.description: Secret used to bind the proof to the committed credential.

constraints: identity_commitment is derived from the private credential material
birth_year is range-constrained to a realistic interval
securityNotes: Use a full birth date if the relying party requires exact age at a specific day.
Bind proofs to a domain or verifier challenge to prevent replay.
Do not expose raw credential identifiers as public inputs.

title: Group Membership
summary: Prove that a private identity leaf belongs to a public Merkle root without revealing which member you are.
statement: I know a leaf and Merkle path that resolve to the public group root.

publicInputs.name: group_root
publicInputs.description: Merkle root representing the current group.

publicInputs.name: scope
publicInputs.description: Application or verifier scope for replay separation.

privateInputs.name: identity_secret
privateInputs.description: Private identity secret used to derive the member leaf.

constraints: indices are constrained to binary values
securityNotes: Version your group roots and publish update cadence.
Avoid small anonymity sets; membership proofs are only as private as the group size.
Use circuit-friendly hash functions consistently across tree construction and circuit verification.

title: Anonymous Vote
summary: Prove vote eligibility and emit a nullifier so each eligible member can vote once.
statement: I am in the eligible voter set, my vote is valid, and my nullifier prevents duplicate voting without revealing my identity.

publicInputs.name: election_id
publicInputs.description: Unique election or proposal identifier.

publicInputs.name: voter_root
publicInputs.description: Merkle root for eligible voters.

publicInputs.name: nullifier
publicInputs.description: One-time public nullifier for this election.

publicInputs.name: vote_commitment
publicInputs.description: Commitment to the private vote value.

constraints: Voter leaf is included in voter_root
vote is constrained to allowed options
securityNotes: Publish and freeze eligible roots before voting starts.
Track nullifiers outside the circuit to reject duplicates.
Consider coercion resistance separately; basic anonymous voting does not solve it.

title: Private Allowlist Claim
summary: Prove that a private address or account is allowlisted without revealing the address itself.
statement: I know an account secret whose leaf is included in the public allowlist root.

publicInputs.name: allowlistRoot
publicInputs.description: Merkle root of the allowlist.

publicInputs.name: claimNullifier
publicInputs.description: Public nullifier for one claim per account.

constraints: claimNullifier is derived from accountSecret and claim scope
securityNotes: Do not use raw wallet addresses as private leaves without salting or committing.
Keep the off-chain allowlist builder deterministic and audited.
Reject reused nullifiers in the application contract or service.

title: Proof of Reserves
summary: Prove assets cover liabilities without exposing every customer balance.
statement: I know committed liabilities and asset balances such that assets are greater than or equal to liabilities.

publicInputs.name: liabilities_root
publicInputs.description: Commitment root for user liabilities.

publicInputs.name: assets_commitment
publicInputs.description: Commitment to asset balances or attestations.

publicInputs.name: solvency_epoch
publicInputs.description: Reporting period identifier.

constraints: liabilities_root is referenced by epoch and published outside the circuit
securityNotes: ZK solvency is not a substitute for asset custody attestations.
Require non-negative user balances and inclusion proofs for customer self-checks.
Define treatment of off-chain, encumbered, or borrowed assets explicitly.

title: Private Token Ownership
summary: Prove ownership of at least one token from a collection without revealing the wallet or token ID.
statement: I know a wallet secret and token leaf included in a public ownership root for the required collection.

publicInputs.name: collection_id
publicInputs.description: Collection, contract, or asset namespace being checked.

publicInputs.name: ownership_root
publicInputs.description: Merkle root of eligible token ownership commitments.

publicInputs.name: access_nullifier
publicInputs.description: Optional nullifier for one access claim per scope.

privateInputs.name: wallet_secret
privateInputs.description: Secret binding the proof to the private wallet or credential.

privateInputs.name: path
privateInputs.description: Merkle sibling path for the ownership commitment.

constraints: Ownership leaf is derived from collection_id, token_id, and wallet_secret
access_nullifier is bound to wallet_secret and collection_id
securityNotes: Define ownership snapshot timing to avoid stale or transferred token claims.
Avoid small collections if holder privacy matters.
Use a deterministic off-chain indexer and publish its snapshot hash.

title: Private Range Proof
summary: Prove a private value falls within a public min/max range without revealing the value.
statement: I know a committed value that is greater than or equal to the lower bound and less than or equal to the upper bound.

publicInputs.name: min_value
publicInputs.description: Inclusive lower bound.

publicInputs.name: max_value
publicInputs.description: Inclusive upper bound.

publicInputs.name: value_commitment
publicInputs.description: Public commitment to the private value.

securityNotes: Use typed integer values for comparisons rather than field-only arithmetic.
Be explicit about units, decimals, and rounding.
Avoid revealing overly narrow bounds when they effectively disclose the value.

title: Anonymous Rate Limit
summary: Let users perform one action per epoch without revealing which user acted.
statement: I am an eligible member and emit an epoch-specific nullifier so only one action is accepted per epoch.

publicInputs.name: membership_root
publicInputs.description: Merkle root of eligible users.

publicInputs.name: epoch
publicInputs.description: Time window or rate-limit bucket.

publicInputs.name: rate_nullifier
publicInputs.description: Public nullifier for this user and epoch.

constraints: Identity leaf is included in membership_root
Path indices are constrained to binary values
securityNotes: Reject duplicate nullifiers in the app or contract.
Choose epochs carefully; short epochs can leak timing patterns.
Keep anonymity sets large enough for the rate-limited action.

title: Private Reputation Threshold
summary: Prove a private reputation score meets a public threshold without revealing the exact score.
statement: I know an issued reputation score and credential secret proving my score is at or above the verifier's threshold.

publicInputs.name: minimum_score
publicInputs.description: Required reputation threshold.

publicInputs.name: issuer_commitment
publicInputs.description: Public commitment to the issuer or credential schema.

publicInputs.name: credential_commitment
publicInputs.description: Commitment to the private score credential.

constraints: credential_commitment binds score, issuer_commitment, and credential_secret
score is range-constrained to the credential schema
securityNotes: Score issuance and revocation are separate trust assumptions.
Use schema/version identifiers to avoid replaying old score formats.
Consider whether threshold choice leaks sensitive reputation bands.

title: Email Domain Credential
summary: Prove control of an email address from an allowed domain without revealing the full address.
statement: I know an email credential whose domain hash matches an allowed public domain commitment.

publicInputs.name: allowed_domain_hash
publicInputs.description: Hash or commitment for the accepted email domain.

publicInputs.name: credential_issuer
publicInputs.description: Issuer identifier or schema commitment.

publicInputs.name: subject_nullifier
publicInputs.description: Optional stable nullifier for one claim per email subject.

privateInputs.name: email_secret
privateInputs.description: Secret tied to the email subject.

constraints: subject_nullifier is derived from email_secret and credential_issuer
securityNotes: Email parsing and canonicalization must happen before credential issuance.
Avoid proving raw domain strings directly inside the circuit unless needed.
Decide whether aliases and plus-addressing should collapse to the same subject.

title: Private Location Eligibility
summary: Prove a private location credential is inside an allowed region without revealing the precise location.
statement: I know a location credential whose bounded coordinates fall inside the verifier's allowed region.

publicInputs.name: min_lat_offset
publicInputs.description: Scaled minimum latitude bound after applying a positive coordinate offset.

publicInputs.name: max_lat_offset
publicInputs.description: Scaled maximum latitude bound after applying a positive coordinate offset.

publicInputs.name: min_lon_offset
publicInputs.description: Scaled minimum longitude bound after applying a positive coordinate offset.

publicInputs.name: max_lon_offset
publicInputs.description: Scaled maximum longitude bound after applying a positive coordinate offset.

privateInputs.name: lat_offset
privateInputs.description: Private scaled latitude after applying a positive coordinate offset.

privateInputs.name: lon_offset
privateInputs.description: Private scaled longitude after applying a positive coordinate offset.

privateInputs.name: credential_secret
privateInputs.description: Secret tying the location to an issued credential.

constraints: lat_offset is between min_lat_offset and max_lat_offset
lon_offset is between min_lon_offset and max_lon_offset
Credential secret binds the proof to an issuer outside the coordinate checks
securityNotes: Bounding boxes are approximate; use region membership sets for irregular boundaries.
Location credentials can be highly sensitive even when approximate.
Use short-lived credentials for live presence claims.

title: Private Web Data Attestation
summary: Prove a signed or TLS-notarized web response contains a required committed value.
statement: I know a private web response and attestation opening that matches a public endpoint and committed field value.

publicInputs.name: endpoint_commitment
publicInputs.description: Commitment to the expected domain, path, and method.

publicInputs.name: field_commitment
publicInputs.description: Commitment to the field value being proven.

publicInputs.name: attestor_key
publicInputs.description: Public attestor or notary key commitment.

privateInputs.name: response_secret
privateInputs.description: Secret opening for the response commitment.

privateInputs.name: attestation_secret
privateInputs.description: Private witness material from the attestation protocol.

constraints: endpoint_commitment is tied to the attested response
securityNotes: Most real TLS-notary systems require specialized verification gadgets.
Parsing must be deterministic and covered by tests.
Separate freshness, endpoint authenticity, and field extraction assumptions.
